domain_title: Data, privacy, confidentiality and intellectual property
title: Privacy and data-subject governance
canonical_definition: Personal-data processing, lawful basis, transparency, rights, privacy risks and impact-assessment duties are operationalized in the system and its lifecycle.

conditions: When personal data may occur in inputs, prompts, logs, outputs, evaluation data or human review.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are personal-data categories, purposes, lawful basis, rights and impact-assessment triggers determined?
Are privacy requirements implemented across architecture, access, logging, retention, providers and user workflows?
Do tests and operational records demonstrate rights fulfilment, deletion, restriction and privacy-control effectiveness?

capability_indicators: Rights can be fulfilled end to end

conditions: Refer a material failure of privacy and data-subject governance to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 1.6 (PDF p. 31), MEASURE 2.10 (PDF p. 35), MANAGE 4.1 (PDF p. 38)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on turning scoped requirements into privacy evaluation and monitoring response. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make privacy and data-subject governance verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: B3 evaluates privacy and data-subject governance using evidence from intent through operation. AP-B3 independently assesses evidence of privacy-by-documentation only.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies an accountable privacy assessment for the personal-data flows, approved purposes, rights routes and impact-review triggers. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates access, retention, provider, logging and rights handling controls linked to the actual data and derived stores. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides a scoped rights exercise tracing identity verification, correction, access restriction or deletion to each in-scope destination. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in privacy and data-subject governance, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide an accountable privacy assessment for the personal-data flows, approved purposes, rights routes and impact-review triggers. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate access, retention, provider, logging and rights handling controls linked to the actual data and derived stores. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide a scoped rights exercise tracing identity verification, correction, access restriction or deletion to each in-scope destination. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how privacy and data-subject governance works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with an accountable privacy assessment for the personal-data flows, approved purposes, rights routes and impact-review triggers. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use a scoped rights exercise tracing identity verification, correction, access restriction or deletion to each in-scope destination to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A documented, authorized retention exception still requires scope, access controls and an accountable disposition.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-B3 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in privacy and data-subject governance
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in privacy and data-subject governance
Evidence remains insufficient for privacy and data-subject governance in the assessed scope
